title: Rolling restart of the deployment
description: Run a rolling restart (kubectl rollout restart) after confirming dependencies are healthy again.

title: Raise container memory request and limit
description: Increase the memory request and limit for the affected container in the Helm values and redeploy.

title: Scale out replicas / raise HPA ceiling
description: Increase replica count or the HPA maximum for the affected deployment.

title: Correct image tag or refresh registry pull credentials
description: Fix the image tag, or re-attach the registry pull secret / AcrPull role, then redeploy.

title: Fix connection pool and raise database connection limit
description: Reduce per-pod pool size, restart leaking pods, and raise max_connections within the approved range.

title: Free disk space safely
description: Compress or rotate logs and prune unused container images and temp files. Never delete application data.

title: Renew TLS certificate and reload the proxy
description: Renew the certificate (Key Vault or certbot), deploy it, and reload Nginx.

title: Release a stale Terraform state lock
description: After confirming no run is active, release the lock with terraform force-unlock using the lock ID.

title: Roll back to the last known good release
description: Roll back the deployment (helm rollback or redeploy the previous tag) and open a defect.

title: Repair Nginx upstream and reload configuration
description: Correct the upstream target or health check, validate with nginx -t, then reload.
